environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet. The migration script runs as part of a CI/CD pipeline triggered by commits to the `migrations/` directory. The DB_USER 'migrator' has full DDL privileges including SUPERUSER on the PostgreSQL 14 instance (RDS). The config file is pulled from an S3 bucket where developers can push tenant onboarding configs. No input validation is performed on the 'description' field from the INI file before interpolation into the COMMENT SQL statement.

config.iam_policy: Full RDS Data API access, S3 read on migrations bucket
